markdown_file: Americas/Ojibwe and Algonquin peoples/041 - Story of a Fast Runner.md

segments.source: Once a hunter was so quick of foot that when he shot his arrow at a beaver plunging into the lake from the shore, he would run down, catch the beaver by the tail before the arrow got to it, and hold it until the arrow struck.
He was a fast runner, indeed.
